canonical: Frozen C01 strict UTF8/JSON/safe-integer/UTF16-member-order semantics unchanged; each own digest omits only own top-level digest. Recompute nested records before aggregate.
supplemental_checks: Independently authorized company/project equals root and every nested record/reference; current registry/coordinator/project auth precedes lookup and final return.
Observation labels are descriptive, not authority; all nested observation objects match the aggregate pair with live_verified=false.
Every retained Message references exactly its paired historical Conversation ID/revision/digest; room_head shares identity/scope but never substitutes for historical refs.

Owner-note-only fixed policy1: unique message IDs and sequences, strictly descending contiguous newest prefix, first sequence=head.revision; paired Conversation revision=message sequence. Each record field/UTF8/digest must satisfy frozen validators.
items.length<=requested_limit<=50; null head only with empty items/none_observed; present head requires nonempty prefix. No count/completeness/cursor/snapshot claim.

Full raw UTF8 input boundary262144 before parse; full actual canonical serialization includes envelope, escaping, head, every nested record and all digests. Never sum decoded text sizes. Byte-limit omissions take precedence over item-limit; none_observed never means complete.
Unknown/corrupt policy, missing latest note/head/revision, or selected-row corruption fails the whole operation, not a successful partial prefix. No skipped middle rows or trimmed bodies.
